caption:
Half marathon in three weeks and Toto's legs feel like bricks. Sports massage or remedial? There's plenty of overlap.

Remedial massage starts with an assessment and targets specific areas that are tight or sore. Sports massage is shaped around your training: brisker before events, slower in recovery weeks. The techniques are often the same. The reason for the session is what changes.

Massage works well alongside strength work, sleep and sensible training load, rather than replacing rehab. If the same spot keeps flaring up, get it assessed.

Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio tailor each session to your sport. Mention your goal when you book online via the link in bio 🏃

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
